messages:
kate: Halcyon asked if we can run a POC to validate sustained 600 qps with p95 <= 50ms for chat. Need load plan, ops runbook, cost estimate, and security answers. Can eng own the bench?

alex: On it. Quick clarifying Qs — which model variant + typical prompt/response sizes? Also confirm they want dedicated capacity or hosted?

kate: They prefer dedicated for isolation but want a cost comparison. Typical convo: single-turn prompt ~40 tokens, response ~120 tokens. Expect a single prefix cached turn, history depth 1. They also expect short bursts up to 1000 qps for <60s.

sam: Plan: benchmark against redwood-m-8k quantized (closest to their target). I'll run our profiler + a wrk-style harness. Ballpark: uncached single-token latency ~4ms on A100; with continuous batching and KV prefix caching we should hit p95 ~35-50ms at 600 qps. Cost estimate: ≈ $8–12 per 1M output tokens for this setup (depends on batching).

alex: Draft load plan below (quick):

```
# Load plan (wrk-like harness)
duration: 10m (main)
ramp: 0 -> 600 qps over 2m
sustain: 8m at 600 qps
bursts: every 5m inject 1000 qps for 30s (to validate tail)
pre-soak: 2h at 400 qps to catch leaks
payload: prompt 40 tokens, gen 120 tokens, 1 prefix cached
metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, cpu/gpu util, queue depth, token/sec, failed requests
```

alex: Config notes: use 4xA100s (initial), 8 inference workers, workspace with NVMe for KV cache. Tune batch windows to 8–12ms for this workload.

maria: Security Qs from Halcyon: they need KMS-backed key management, SOC2 controls, and proof that user data is not persisted in logs. Also, requirement to redact PII from logs before export. Can we confirm encryption at rest + in transit?

kate: Yep they asked specifically for VPC + dedicated control plane. Also want timeline for a security questionnaire. Finance will ask about monthly commit vs on-demand pricing.

ryan: I'll prepare the runbook + example dashboards (latency heatmap, token burn, error trace). Recommendation: enable KV prefix caching for common system prompts — should cut token cost ~20–30% for their usage pattern. I also suggest a 2h soak at 400 qps before the main 10m run to avoid surprises.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created cluster red-halcyon-01 (4xA100) for benchmark. Pods: inf-1..4. Bench harness image queued.

sam: Running smoke now (3m). Early results: sustained 600 qps smoke => p95 48ms, p50 18ms. During a synthetic 1k qps 30s burst we saw p99 up to 210ms and a few transient queue overflows — need to tweak batching window and eviction TTL.

alex: Action items & ETA:
1) finish 2h soak at 400 qps (sam) — ETA: later today
2) run full 10m sustained + 3 scheduled bursts, export dashboards (ryan) — ETA: EOD tomorrow
3) security questionnaire draft (maria) — ETA: EOD today
4) cost calc + quote for 1-month reserved vs on-demand (kate + finance) — ETA: 48h

kate: Perfect. @maria please draft the security response and attach SOC2/KMS snippets. @ryan can you produce a preliminary quote based on 3-day dedicated runway + token projection? :thumbsup:

ryan: Yep — will put numbers together after the full run and include a sensitivity table (batching, quantization).

sam: Noted tuning items: increase batch window to 12ms during bursts, adjust KV TTL from 30s->60s for this workload, and enable conservative fallback model for overload to preserve success rate.

kate: Thanks team — will update Halcyon with tentative schedule.

alex: ping if anyone needs additional infra. Will collect the perf traces and attach to the final writeup. :white_check_mark:
